+---
+depends_on:
+- 01M21A9KJGPPJE0X01JE0B9V33

+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9080'
+title: ConnectionStore, ConnectionsView, ConnectionRow, ConnectionStatusChip, and AuthorizationPresenter (plan §12)
+---
+## What
+Create `Sources/AgentViewKit/Connections/ConnectionStore.swift`, `ConnectionsView.swift`, `ConnectionRow.swift`, `ConnectionStatusChip.swift`, and `AuthorizationPresenter.swift`, per plan.md §12.
+
+- `Connection`: `id`, `name`, `state` (`disconnected`, `connected`, `needsAuth`, `authenticating`, `expired`, `error(String)`), `tools: [ToolToggle]`.
+- `ConnectionStore` (`@MainActor @Observable`): `connections`, `transition(id, to:)` with the allowed edges from §12 (a disallowed edge is a no-op and logs), `setToolEnabled(connectionID, toolID, Bool)`. Delegates `connect(id)` and `disconnect(id)` to a `ConnectionActions` protocol the host implements.
+- `EnvironmentValues.connectionStore` and `.connectionStore(_:)`.
+- `ConnectionStatusChip(state)`: a dot and a label per state, with an accessibility label.
+- `ConnectionRow` and `ConnectionsView`: a `List` with Connect or Disconnect per row and per-tool toggles.
+- `AuthorizationPresenter` (`@MainActor`): wraps `ASWebAuthenticationSession`. `present(url:callbackScheme:ephemeral:) async throws -> URL`. Supplies the `NSWindow` presentation anchor from the key window. Returns the callback URL. Touches no OAuth protocol.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `transition` from `connected` to `needsAuth` succeeds; from `disconnected` to `expired` is a no-op.
+- [ ] The chip shows six distinct labels for the six states.
+- [ ] `ConnectionsView` shows one row per connection and a toggle per tool.
+- [ ] `AuthorizationPresenter` exposes `prefersEphemeralWebBrowserSession` and throws `cancelled` when the session ends without a callback.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Connections/ConnectionStoreTests.swift`: the edge table.
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Connections/ConnectionsViewHostedTests.swift`: rows, toggles, and chip labels through accessibility.
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Connections/AuthorizationPresenterTests.swift`: the cancel path with an injected session factory.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter AgentViewKitTests` exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
